subassemblies.name: 电机—两级减速—后桥总成

groups.limits: 子总成以同一刚体平移，逐组检查已安装总成；内部零件相对位置不变。未检查连续扫掠路径。分组内部逐件装配另见 insertion。

parallel_internal.limits: 独立子总成工位内，每批次7时刻检查移动零件间及前序已装件；批内同时、批间顺序。不含其他总成或连续路径。

insertion.limits: 按声明的直线插入方向、距离和父先子后步骤，在每步7个时刻检查已安装零件；离散采样可能漏过薄障碍物或采样间穿透，不是连续碰撞/扫掠体证明。

checks.limits: 静态装配姿态 B-rep 体积交集检查；不证明运动全过程或装配插入路径无碰撞。配合检查为名义尺寸，未含制造公差。轴承滚道/螺纹/预紧为简化。

operation.limits: 限定转向/车轮相位组合的 B-rep 离散采样，extended 含异相轮位；完全相同刚体变换复用静态/已算交集。未穷举独立相位、全转角域、连续轨迹、轮胎接触和动力学。

transmission.limits: 20°直齿渐开线样条插值近似，直线简化齿根；未建模刀具根切/圆角、弹性接触、齿面应力、润滑与效率。差速内部仍为理想平均关系。

checks: real settings creates 72-part racecar with valid static/insertion/group/batch/30-pose motion checks
independent shell visibility/transparent inspection preserves physical assembled state
4:1 keyed two-stage reduction rotates actual gear CAD meshes with ratio residual checked
independent wheel phases and Ackermann steering remain linked to differential mean input
15-second motion observation advances and explicit pause freezes wheel state
shell-only explosion stops/resets operation and reassembly restores readiness
five shell pieces can be assembled individually at a dedicated work station
complex powertrain retains individual/parallel batch assembly
whole-car integration gates operation until all subassemblies are installed
sandboxed gzip-embedded STEP decompresses to exact verified export bytes

performance.scope: Current PC, hidden shell, 72 CAD solids, first-party WebGL; no low-end or full-cycle certification

evidence.implementation: Independent first-party bounded data factories. Single-part insertion; rigid whole subassemblies; sequential batches with simultaneous parts. Typed ideal Ackermann front pivots and independent wheel phases, ideal differential rotor uses mean rear speed. Body held fixed on a demonstration stand. Dynamic geometry uses world-space rigid transforms, no scripts in input. Python/JS numeric transforms match to 1e-9.
limits: 72 nominal solids, 9 subassemblies, two gear stages 18:36 then 24:48, total reduction4:1, root world poses, ideal keyed relation without keyway solids, 5 detachable bored/cockpit/nose/side shells and wing
Differential internal gears, tie rods, fasteners and wire harness are simplified or omitted
Motor/traction loads, tyre deformation and road contact are not solved
Changing inspection scope restores completed pose; it is a teaching viewer, not manual snap-to-assemble game or assembly training record

30 selected steering/independent-phase B-rep checks passed; not exhaustive or continuous. An earlier full native run hit CPU30s. Identical rigid pair caching preserves checks. 96 simple boxes passed but this does not prove 96 gears. CPU30s/wall45s/RAM1GiB unchanged
Seven insertion samples can miss thin obstacles
CAD valid export is not manufacturing certification
No images supplied to this text reviewer

WebGL uses same checked CAD meshes; earlier SVG run 0.92fps with 56628 faces, WebGL separate same-PC run17.79fps. See latest browser record for final-run timing. Compressed embedded STEP downloads verified against original SHA256; renderer is first party and offline
